g.data-latex: \mathcal{L}_{\text{adv}} = -\mathbb{E}_{z, I_{s}} [D(G(z, I_{s}))] \\ \mathcal{L}_{D} = \mathbb{E}[D(G(z, I_{s}))] - \mathbb{E}[D(I_{t})] + \lambda_{gp}\mathbb{E}[(||\nabla_{\hat{x}} D(\hat{x})||_2 - 1)^2] \\ \mathcal{L}_{\text{L1}} = \mathbb{E}_{I_{s}, I_{t}} [ || G(z, I_{s}) - I_{t} ||_1 ] \\ \mathcal{L}_{\text{Total}} = \mathcal{L}_{\text{adv}} + \lambda_{L1} \cdot \mathcal{L}_{\text{L1}}
g.data-semantic-attributes: latex: \mathcal{L}_{\text{adv}} = -\mathbb{E}_{z, I_{s}} [D(G(z, I_{s}))] \\ \mathcal{L}_{D} = \mathbb{E}[D(G(z, I_{s}))] - \mathbb{E}[D(I_{t})] + \lambda_{gp}\mathbb{E}[(||\nabla_{\hat{x}} D(\hat{x})||_2 - 1)^2] \\ \mathcal{L}_{\text{L1}} = \mathbb{E}_{I_{s}, I_{t}} [ || G(z, I_{s}) - I_{t} ||_1 ] \\ \mathcal{L}_{\text{Total}} = \mathcal{L}_{\text{adv}} + \lambda_{L1} \cdot \mathcal{L}_{\text{L1}}
